title: Implement catalog_detail_cache component
description:
Implement catalog_detail_cache.py for the catalog-api project using the component API described in README.md.

The approved response-cache agreement for catalog readers is stored in Beads memory under key `catalog-api.response-cache` (Architecture approval CACHE-17, 2026-09-06, v1). Recall that key to obtain the full policy before implementing. This same approved agreement applies because catalog_detail_cache is another catalog reader that should share the same response-cache behavior.

The component must export:
- `POLICY`: the complete approved nested policy dict (project + cache fields)
- `SOURCE`: the exact approval source string from the agreement
- `RATIONALE`: the exact rationale string from the agreement
- `create_cache(clock)`: returns a working ResponseCache governed by that policy

Do not delete or modify catalog_cache.py or any other existing project files. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` to verify the public API contract.
